references.notes: Operator's explicit style target. This is an `owl` build, so the template itself is the authoritative source of structure — read from astro-templates/owl/ rather than scraped. Section order, component set, and type treatment are cloned verbatim; only brand tokens and copy change.
Original reference behind the owl template. Consulted for lineage only; gilroy supersedes it as the concrete target.

known_drift_from_reference: astro-templates/owl/ has advanced past the gilroy-roofing deployment. Two visible deltas: (1) the visual breadcrumb trail is now hidden site-wide (commits e09a329, 440f21b), where gilroy still renders it on inner pages; (2) the closing CTA was reworked and its copy moved into the component (commit 5380c60). Both are deliberate template improvements, not regressions.

sites/gilroy-roofing/src is a STALE SNAPSHOT and must not be used as the build source. It predates the brand-token generalisation (its Header hardcodes rgba(241,85,55,...) — Gilroy's orange), the --color-accent-ink token, and src/lib/limits.ts. Building from it would reintroduce all three.
ACTION: after the build, diff the rendered result against gilroy-roofing.vercel.app section by section and report any delta beyond these two known items.

palette._derivation: Operator supplied three colors: #e1c135 (CTA), #ffffff (primary bg), #0a0a0a (secondary bg). Everything else is derived and contrast-verified against WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI).

--color-surface.note: Operator specified #ffffff for the background. Gilroy inverts this — tinted bg (#f0f2f7) with white cards. Pure white on pure white would erase every card edge, so the tint moves to the card instead. Delta is small but sufficient; a hairline border backs it up.

--color-primary.role: dark panels — Testimonials, ProcessSteps, WhyChooseUs, Footer
--color-primary.note: Maps to gilroy's --color-primary: #000000. Same structural role.

--color-accent.role: FILL only — button backgrounds, dark-panel accents, icon fills
--color-accent.warning: 1.77:1 as text on white. FAILS AA badly. Never use --color-accent as foreground text on a light background. Use --color-accent-ink.

--color-accent-ink.role: the accent as FOREGROUND TEXT on light backgrounds — eyebrows, tick marks, stars, pins, chevrons, phone links
--color-accent-ink.note: Template default is #8a6420 (derived from owl's #c8973f). Re-derived here from the client's #e1c135 per the template README's per-client rule. Dark panels keep --color-accent (11.2:1 on #0a0a0a); light backgrounds use this ink.

typography.source: identical to gilroy-roofing — unchanged for style fidelity
typography.note: intake-scraped.json detected no fonts on the client site (brand.fonts null), so the reference's fonts carry through rather than being overridden.

spacing_radius.note: Inherited verbatim from the owl template. Identical to gilroy.

section_order_home: hero (photo bg + eyebrow + headline + subhead + trust badges + CTA, form aside)
seo body (why choose + floating review card)
anti_patterns: Never use --color-accent (#e1c135) as text on a light background — 1.77:1.
No emoji as interface icons. The client's existing site does this; the template uses inline SVG from src/lib/icons.ts.
No hotlinked third-party images. All imagery served from public/img/.
No unverified rating or review count in the hero trust badges, above the form, or in JSON-LD aggregateRating. Rating and review_count are null in intake and must stay out of the build.
No specific warranty term anywhere. Two 1-star reviews concern warranty non-response; publishing a term Dan has not confirmed creates a real liability.
No 'since YYYY' claim — founding year is contested (2015 vs 2018) and unresolved.
No randomised or reshuffled section order. Fixed per v2.2 amendment E.
Never synthesize GHL loader URLs or widget IDs — operator paste-in only.
Do not copy layout, component styling, or section rhythm from ir-ga.com. The template is the sole source of design.
